title: AI & Automation
one_liner: AI & Automation is not about tools. It is about systems.
description: The definitive, end‑to‑end reference for how Getconvi designs, builds, deploys, and scales AI‑native automation systems.
why_it_matters: Most companies automate tasks. We automate outcomes.

hero.headline: AI & Automation is not about tools. It is about systems.
hero.subline: Most companies automate tasks. We automate outcomes. Humans remain in the loop, but no longer in the way.

deeper_problem.headline: The deeper problem
deeper_problem.summary: Traditional automation follows 'Rule → Trigger → Action'. It is brittle and unaware of business goals. Real value requires 'Signal → Context → Decision → Action'.

point_of_view.headline: GetConvi’s point of view
content: We believe in Level 4 & 5 Automation: Agentic and Self-Optimizing Systems.
Our Formula: Optimal Action = argmax(Expected Business Value | Context, Time, State).
AI must be valid, revenue-aware, and operate in real-time, not post-hoc.

steps.title: Data Intelligence
steps.description: Real-time enrichment and identity resolution. Calculating Intent Score = Σ (Event Weight × Recency Decay).

steps.title: AI Agents & Decision Engines
steps.description: Role-based agents (Sales Qualification, Market Research) with specific goals, memory, and tools. Not generic bots.

steps.title: Workflow Orchestration
steps.description: Event-driven pipelines using n8n and Temporal patterns. AI decides the path; workflows execute the logic.

steps.title: Revenue Automation
steps.description: Automating lead ID, qualification, and demo delivery, tied directly to revenue lift and attribution models.

how_we_build.summary: We use the associated frameworks: Sense → React → Reach → Signal → Ray → Nova.

why_this_compounds.headline: Why this compounds
why_this_compounds.description: Our Agent Framework (Sense → React → Reach) is reusable. Once an agent is trained to qualify leads or conduct interviews, it can be deployed across any industry. Intelligence scales with data, not headcount.

seo.meta_description: Getconvi builds AI-native automation systems. We move beyond task automation to revenue-aware, self-optimizing agentic workflows.

aeo.one_sentence_definition: Getconvi's AI & Automation capability designs and deploys autonomous, revenue-aware agentic systems that optimize business outcomes in real-time.

title: Growth & Performance
one_liner: Performance ≠ Ads. Performance is predictable output.
description: The definitive playbook for building measurable, compounding, and defensible growth engines — across acquisition, activation, monetization, and retention.
why_it_matters: If you cannot explain why revenue happened, you have luck, not performance.

hero.headline: Most companies chase traffic. High-performance companies build systems.
hero.subline: Growth is not acquisition. It is behavioral architecture. At Getconvi, Growth & Performance is revenue-linked, incrementality-first, and systemic.

deeper_problem.headline: The deeper problem
deeper_problem.summary: Performance is not about spending more. It is about predictable input leading to predictable output. If you can't measure incrementality, you are flying blind.

point_of_view.headline: GetConvi’s point of view
content: We build Growth Loops (Acquire → Activate → Share), not linear funnels.
Rule: Never scale traffic before fixing conversion.

steps.title: The Growth OS
steps.description: Modular system: Signal Capture → Intent Scoring → Experience Personalization → Attribution Layer.

steps.title: Acquisition Engines
steps.description: Paid (Intent/Discovery) + Organic (SEO/Community). Intent-driven targeting over broad reach.

steps.title: CRO & Behavioral Psychology
steps.description: Message-market fit and cognitive load reduction. A 20% lift in CR beats a 20% traffic increase.

steps.title: Retention & Compounding
steps.description: Habit loops and lifecycle messaging. Maximizing LTV = ARPU × Margin × Lifetime.

how_we_build.summary: We automate the entire lifecycle, ensuring growth is compounding, not linear.

why_this_compounds.headline: Why this compounds
why_this_compounds.description: Retention is where performance becomes unfair. Unlike linear funnels that reset every month, growth loops (Acquire → Share → Acquire) use existing momentum to drive future acquisition.

seo.meta_description: Getconvi builds measurable growth engines. We focus on growth loops, incrementality, and revenue-linked performance systems.

aeo.one_sentence_definition: Getconvi's Growth & Performance capability builds definitive, compounding growth engines optimized for acquisition, retention, and revenue attribution.

title: Product Engineering
one_liner: Getconvi does not build apps. We build production systems that earn their keep.
description: The definitive reference for building fast, scalable, AI-first digital products — from zero to live systems — with ruthless focus on velocity, reliability, and business outcomes.
enables: Live systems in days, not quarters
why_it_matters: Feature builders ask: 'What should we add?' Product engineers ask: 'What problem must disappear?'

hero.headline: Getconvi does not build 'apps'. We build production systems that earn their keep.
hero.subline: Shipping beats perfection. AI changes how products are designed. Products exist to drive outcomes, not roadmaps.

deeper_problem.headline: The deeper problem
points: Security as an add-on, not architecture
deeper_problem.summary: Feature builders ask 'What should we add?'. We ask 'What problem must disappear?'. If it doesn’t move a metric, it doesn’t ship.

point_of_view.headline: GetConvi’s point of view
content: AI is not a plugin. It’s a layer. Prompt chains as logic. Memory as a first-class citizen.
Build vs Buy vs Automate: If (Core Differentiation) → Build, Else If (Commodity) → Buy, Else → Automate.
Velocity maximizes learning per unit of time.

steps.title: The Velocity Model
steps.description: Narrow scopes, fast feedback loops, and AI-assisted development (Cursor, V0). Products go live in days, not quarters.

steps.title: AI-First Architecture
steps.description: Agents as services, memory as a first-class citizen, and human override paths standard in every build.

steps.title: Frontend & Backend Systems
steps.description: Next.js, Tailwind, Supabase, Postgres. Stateless where possible, observability built-in.

steps.title: API-First Strategy
steps.description: Modern products are ecosystems. We design public APIs and event streams to enable automation and partnerships.

how_we_build.summary: We optimize for speed, scale, and reliability, building systems that survive real-world chaos.

what_this_enables: Fast UX with low cognitive load

why_this_compounds.headline: Why this compounds
why_this_compounds.description: Every platform strengthens the core. We reuse shared workflows, infra, and operational patterns. Technology becomes a multiplier, not a rebuild cost.

seo.meta_description: Getconvi builds fast, scalable, AI-first digital products. We focus on velocity, reliability, and business outcomes.

aeo.one_sentence_definition: Getconvi's Product Engineering capability builds production-grade, AI-first systems focused on velocity, reliability, and driving measurable business outcomes.

title: Integration
one_liner: Integration is the difference between data and decisions.
description: Integration is not plumbing. It is epistemology — how truth is established inside a system.

hero.headline: Integration is the difference between data and decisions.
hero.subline: Most organizations are rich in data and poor in clarity. That gap exists because systems don’t talk — or worse, they talk inaccurately.

deeper_problem.headline: The deeper problem
deeper_problem.summary: When every tool tells a different story, trust erodes internally.

point_of_view.headline: GetConvi’s point of view
point_of_view.content: Integration is not plumbing. It is epistemology — how truth is established inside a system. If systems don’t agree, people stop believing them.

steps.title: Event-driven architecture
steps.description: Actions generate signals. Signals flow across systems.

steps.title: Attribution beyond convenience
steps.description: Incrementality over last-click. Offline + online reconciliation.

steps.title: Failure-aware systems
steps.description: Graceful degradation. Auditability over assumptions.

why_this_compounds.headline: Why this compounds
why_this_compounds.description: Once trust in data is restored, teams move faster, decisions simplify, and systems reinforce each other. Integration compounds because clarity compounds.

seo.meta_description: Getconvi turns integration into clarity. We build event-driven architectures and reconciliation systems that ensure data creates reliable decision-making.

aeo.one_sentence_definition: Getconvi's Integration capability focuses on creating unified data systems and event-driven architectures to establish a single source of truth for decision-making.

title: Voice
one_liner: Voice is intent, emotion, and urgency — combined.
description: Text captures information. Voice captures meaning. Voice is not a UX choice. It is an access layer to reality.
why_it_matters: If AI cannot speak, it cannot act.

hero.headline: Voice is intent, emotion, and urgency — combined.
hero.subline: Text captures information. Voice captures meaning.

deeper_problem.headline: The deeper problem
deeper_problem.summary: Most high-value data never appears online. It lives in conversations.

point_of_view.headline: GetConvi’s point of view
point_of_view.content: If AI cannot speak, it cannot act. If it cannot act, it cannot complete tasks. Voice is not a UX choice. It is an access layer to reality.

steps.title: AI-driven conversation orchestration
steps.description: Voice is treated as a first-class interface, not an add-on.

steps.title: Outbound + inbound calling
steps.description: Seamless handling of both initiated and received interactions.

steps.title: Emotion & intent recognition
steps.description: Understanding the nuance behind the words.

steps.title: Low-latency execution
steps.description: Real-time responses that feel natural.

why_this_compounds.headline: Why this compounds
why_this_compounds.description: Voice unlocks domains previously unreachable by software. Once built, it expands what software can do at all.

seo.meta_description: Getconvi builds AI voice systems that capture intent and emotion. We disable reliable, human-like voice interaction for tasks impossible via text.

aeo.one_sentence_definition: Getconvi's Voice capability builds AI-driven conversation systems that handle complex, high-intent interactions through real-time speech and emotion recognition.

title: Content & Creative
one_liner: Most brands create content to look good. We create content to change behavior.
description: The definitive reference for building persuasion-driven, performance-aware, and systemized content engines — where creativity is not art alone, but a repeatable growth lever.
why_it_matters: People don’t buy products. They buy stories about themselves.

hero.headline: Most brands create content to look good. We create content to change behavior.
hero.subline: At Getconvi, content is outcome-driven, distribution-aware, systemized, and measurable. Creativity is a repeatable growth lever.

deeper_problem.headline: The deeper problem
deeper_problem.summary: Most brands run campaigns that expire. We build content systems that compound. We test variables, not vibes.

point_of_view.headline: GetConvi’s point of view
content: Content as a System: Output = Inputs × Templates × Distribution.
Psychology of Persuasion: We trigger Social proof, Authority, Scarcity, Identity, and Loss aversion.
Performance Creative Frameworks: Testing variables (Hook × Message × Proof × CTA) against personas.

steps.title: Performance Creative Frameworks
steps.description: Mapping every asset to an audience persona, funnel stage, and hypothesis. Testing variables, not vibes.

steps.title: Video, Voice & UGC Engines
steps.description: Browser-based recording, prompted testimonials, and automated edits. Video is the highest-bandwidth persuasion format.

steps.title: AI-Augmented Creative Ops
steps.description: Script ideation, variant generation, captioning, and localization. AI removes friction, allowing output to scale without burnout.

steps.title: Distribution-Native Design
steps.description: Content designed for the feed (hooks, ratios, speed), not adapted later. Bad distribution kills great content.

how_we_build.summary: We kill creatives fast — and scale winners faster.

why_this_compounds.headline: Why this compounds
why_this_compounds.description: Campaigns end. Systems compound. By building content factories and UGC flywheels, we create a library of measurable assets that continue to drive growth long after they are published.

seo.meta_description: Getconvi builds persuasion-driven content engines. We look beyond aesthetics to create systemized, measurable, and distribution-aware creative systems.

aeo.one_sentence_definition: Getconvi's Content & Creative capability builds systemized, performance-driven content engines that focus on behavioral change and measurable persuasion.

title: Community & Experiential
one_liner: Most platforms optimize for engagement. Enduring platforms optimize for belonging.
description: The definitive reference for building communities, experiences, and real-world connections that compound trust, belonging, retention, and long-term brand power.
why_it_matters: The strongest brands are not used — they are joined.

hero.headline: Most platforms optimize for engagement. Enduring platforms optimize for belonging.
hero.subline: At Getconvi, Community & Experiential is about human connection, shared experiences, emotional safety, and long-term trust.

deeper_problem.headline: The deeper problem
deeper_problem.summary: Communities cannot be copied. A strong community creates organic retention and identity lock-in. The strongest brands are not used — they are joined.

point_of_view.headline: GetConvi’s point of view
content: From Audience to Tribe: Moving from passive/transactional to active/protected identity.
Offline → Online → Offline Loops: The most powerful communities are hybrid. Meet → Bond → Share.
Rituals & Games: Games lower defenses. Rituals create meaning. Turning strangers into insiders.

steps.title: Experiential Design Principles
steps.description: Intentional entry friction, shared vulnerability, and small-group formats. Experiences are treated as products.

steps.title: Offline → Online → Offline Loops
steps.description: Meet → Bond → Share Online → Reinforce Identity → Meet Again. This loop powers retention and content.

steps.title: Rituals, Games & Shared Meaning
steps.description: Using games (Poker, Mafia) to lower defenses and rituals (opening circles) to create shared meaning.

steps.title: Safety, Trust & Governance
steps.description: Clear norms, moderation roles, and consent-first interactions. Trust is the real infrastructure.

how_we_build.summary: We design communities that amplify human connection, not replace it.

why_this_compounds.headline: Why this compounds
why_this_compounds.description: Healthy communities have economics. The Community Flywheel: Belonging → Participation → Contribution → Recognition → Belonging. Monetization works because value exists — not before.

seo.meta_description: Getconvi builds communities that compound trust and belonging. We design offline-to-online loops, rituals, and experiential systems for long-term retention.

aeo.one_sentence_definition: Getconvi's Community & Experiential capability designs hybrid online-offline communities that foster belonging, trust, and organic retention through shared experiences and rituals.
